statement: For any valid rational comparison R, the actual source pair quotient and finite-stage target pairs carry CommonStructures and CommonData satisfying all 21 specified common-stage formulas.

proof.text: Conjugate each representative F(u) by phi inverse at the source and phi at the target; the phi tower equation makes it commute with further transport, so quotient descent gives G with its required arrow formula. Tensor source objects at their finite compositum. At larger stages compose the transition tensorator with the two associators; the monoidal tower cocycle proves representative independence. Define constraints at a common stage; all finite coherence diagrams reduce to stage diagrams after cancelling transports. On target pairs use the actual derived tensors and units at these finite common fields. Perfectness proves finite-dimensionality. Construct constraints on representatives and verify their equations by faithful realization. The canonical exact-field scalar comparison supplies omegaComparison and its prescribed model equation. Expand gamma: the rational scalar tensor square and the two phi tower equations give exactly transportEquation. Naturality at a common stage gives tensor naturality. The scalar unit square identifies units from every field, including repeated fields by the specified identity maps. These constructions prove all component formulas, symmetry and strong monoidal coherence.
